name: Can I paint or stain my interior window trim, and when is it done?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint or stain my interior window trim, and when is it done?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, interior window trim can be painted or stained, depending on the material and desired aesthetic. Wood trim offers the versatility of both options, while MDF is best suited for painting. PVC trim usually comes pre-finished or can be painted with specific primers. Typically, painting or staining is the final step after the trim has been installed, caulked, and filled. This ensures a clean, uniform finish without smudges or inconsistencies. As part of our service, we discuss finish options and timing to integrate seamlessly with your overall home improvement project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim can be painted or stained, with wood suitable for both and MDF best for painting. Finishing is done after installation.
